title: emergencyTransfer sweeps phUSD/rewardToken without zeroing accounting, permanently bricking pauseWithdraw and turning the documented 'emergency exit' into a principal-loss trap

knownIssueCheck.candidate: KI-5 'Owner trust assumptions - centralized control for pausing, APY setting, yield accumulator configuration'
knownIssueCheck.rationale: Generic 'owner trust assumption' does NOT extend to silently breaking the protocol's documented emergency-exit escape hatch (pauseWithdraw). The accounting-drift defect makes pauseWithdraw revert post-call, which is a concrete on-chain DoS, not an acknowledged owner power. Extra scrutiny applied per High-severity caution rule; finding survives.

c4InvalidCheck.rationale: Not a 'reckless admin mistake' — defect is structural: the function ALWAYS bricks pauseWithdraw, regardless of admin intent.
